text:
emma: Heads-up — CloudCo asked for a really small-footprint Terraform starter that provisions a 1-GPU LLM demo + simple ingress so EPDs can spin up a validation run. Want to propose a "slim-starter" layout: minimal VPC, single subnet, autoscaling node pool (1-2), and a prebuilt refarch that uses our marketplace image.

raj: Nice. Can we make it modular so customers can drop in Dedicated vs Hosted configs? e.g., a module for infra + a module for redwood_deploy.

emma: yes, that's the idea. two modules: cloudco_iac/core and cloudco_iac/redwood-deploy. core handles network/iam/instance profile; redwood-deploy wraps our marketplace AMI + startup script.

linda: QA checklist — assume we need smoke tests: 1) instance boots, 2) service responds to /health, 3) small 8-token generation via test prompt. Anything else?

sean: packaging note: Cloud marketplace needs a manifest and a 1-click install script. We should include an examples/marketplace directory and a cloud-init snippet.

emma: agreed. I'll draft the repo layout. rough sketch: 
```
cloudco-iac-slim/
  modules/
    core/
    redwood_deploy/
  examples/
    demo-1gpu/
    marketplace/
  tests/
    smoke/
  docs/
    QUICKSTART.md
```

raj: For modules, add outputs for endpoint URL, instance_ids, and a flag output "uses_marketplace_image". That helps automation.

linda: For tests, can we wire CI to run smoke on PRs and also a nightly conformance matrix across regions? Maybe reduce matrix to eu-west-1 and us-west-2 initially.

sean: also include a terraform fmt + tflint GH action. marketplace packaging will want a small deploy script we can hand to CloudCo engineers.

emma: timeline: draft repo + GH actions by EOD Wed, internal review Thu, partner preview next Tue. Can folks pick up tasks?

raj: I'll own core module (network/iam/test coverage). ETA Thu morning.

linda: I'll write smoke tests and CI YAML. ETA Thu afternoon.

sean: I'll do marketplace manifest + 1-click script. ETA Mon partner preview.

partner_eng_bot: Reminder: please attach partner NDA tag when handing artifacts to external CloudCo. See https://internal.redwood/partners/nda-guidelines

emma: thanks! one more ask — can we include a tiny example of `terraform taint` recovery steps in QUICKSTART for customers who hit transient AMI boot issues? Saves a bunch of support tickets.

raj: good call. i'll add a troubleshooting section with `terraform taint module.redwood_deploy.aws_instance.demo` example.

linda: ping me when repo is public internal so I can wire the CI secrets (testuser creds + small quota).

sean: once we have the marketplace bundle ready, I'll coordinate with CloudCo PM for a joint announcement checklist (images, docs, screenshots, one-liner).

emma: perfect. leaving this thread open for quick updates — drop short status replies only. :thumbsup:

linda: smoke tests PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/cloudco-iac-slim/pull/3 (WIP).

raj: core module PR up: https://github.com/redwood/cloudco-iac-slim/pull/4 — basic networking and outputs.

sean: marketplace manifest draft in `examples/marketplace/manifest.json` pushed. need review for required fields.

partner_eng_bot: Deployment checklist template created: https://internal.redwood/partners/deploy-checklist. Use `cloudco-slim` tag.

emma: thanks team — thumbs up if hit your ETAs or mark if blocked.

raj: on track.

linda: blocked on dev account quota, filing request with infra.

sean: on track. will sync with CloudCo PM tomorrow.

emma: noted — linda, I can escalate quota. ping me in DMs.

sean: FYI will add a short note in QUICKSTART about cost estimates for the 1-GPU demo.

emma: excellent. end of thread for now.
